name: Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin
summary: The sealed letter carries word from Arathi Highlands to Archmage Malin in Stormwind. Its arrival brings news of companions preparing to return home.

sections.title: Word from Arathi
sections.body: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Archmage Malin opens the letter and recognizes the news it bears. Trelane will be pleased, and Kryten and Skuerto are eager to make their way back to Stormwind. Malin thanks the courier and offers help for the road ahead.

faq.answer: The sealed letter is addressed to Archmage Malin in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Where does the letter come from?
faq.answer: The letter comes from Arathi Highlands, where Kryten and Skuerto say they will soon be home.
It tells Archmage Malin that Kryten and Skuerto will soon be home.
Kryten is one of the companions expected to return to Stormwind with Skuerto.
Skuerto is one of the companions expected to return to Stormwind with Kryten.

attribution: Wowpedia: Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin
